title: Flexbox
goal: Arrange and align items along a main axis.
explanation: display: flex makes direct children flex items. The flex-direction property defines the main axis: row follows the inline direction, while column follows the block direction.

justify-content distributes free space along the main axis. align-items aligns items along the cross axis. With a row in a normal horizontal writing mode, these are horizontal and vertical respectively.

Use gap for consistent spacing and flex-wrap: wrap when items should move to another line. For a responsive navigation bar, combine semantic nav links with wrapping; use a media query to switch to a column if needed.
exercise: Arrange three cards in a row and stack them below 48rem. Resize the preview to test both layouts.
hint: Put display: flex on the parent, not each card.

quiz.question: Which property controls distribution along the main axis?
quiz.explanation: justify-content follows the main axis. Its direction changes when flex-direction changes.
